_comment: Merge these into your Firebase Realtime Database rules.
_instructions: 1. Open Firebase Console → Realtime Database → Rules tab
2. Merge the 'rules' object below into your existing rules JSON

$recipientUid._comment_read: Only the recipient can read their own mailbox — each entry is already ciphertext sealed to them specifically via the 1:1 X3DH/Double-Ratchet session, but no reason to let anyone else even fetch it.

$fromUid._comment_write: Only an existing member of the group can drop a Sender Key distribution blob, and only under their OWN uid as the sender — matches GroupE2EManager's client write path (groupSenderKeys/{groupId}/{recipientUid}/{fromUid}).
$fromUid..write: auth != null && auth.uid === $fromUid && root.child('groups/' + $groupId + '/members/' + auth.uid).val() === true
